entities.name: Emmanuel Kiwanuka Nsubuga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Emmanuel Kiwanuka Nsubuga was a Uganda Catholic prelate who served as the first Archbishop of Kampala from 1966 to 1990 and as a cardinal from 1976 until his death. He was an outspoken critic of human rights abuses of the military dictatorship of Idi Amin.
